verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official GitLab MCP server documented at docs.gitlab.com/user/gitlab_duo/model_context_protocol/mcp_server/. Separately, GitLab Orbit exposes MCP tools that let any MCP-compatible agent query GitLab data, and tool policies are enforced for all connecting clients. Missing for 10: details on the main MCP server's tool coverage, setup and auth flow (the probe confirms only that the page exists), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through it.
